title: payment-api: elevated latency and 5xx during the evening sale
symptoms: gateway returned 502/504 for a subset of routes
p95 and p99 latency climbing together
pool wait count climbing on the affected service
elevated 5xx rate on the alerting service
threads waiting to acquire a database connection
observed_signals: pool stats showed checked-out connections near max with a wait queue
timeout-related WARN/ERROR rate on the service rose from near zero
latency jumped by more than 10x while CPU stayed only moderately higher
downstream_latency_ms on callers increased as they waited on payment-api

timeline.event: traffic was unremarkable until a heavy query pattern hit payment-api
p95 latency on payment-api began climbing
connection wait logs appeared on payment-api
mitigation applied; latency and waits receded

contributing_factors: a missing index plus lock waits held connections for seconds
the acquire timeout was shorter than the slow query
resolution: terminated the long-running query and added an index plus statement_timeout
cleared lock contention on the hot table
documented the query in the runbook
lessons_learned: statement_timeout would have bounded the lock hold time
treat connection-wait logs as a first-class signal during latency incidents
